labels.diagramLabel: The eight steps from commit to evidence. Choose a step to read what happens.

steps.title: Scan.
steps.body: Scanners run inside your repository and write structured results. Nothing is uploaded.

steps.title: Clean up.
steps.body: Duplicate findings are merged and each one gets a stable ID, so "new" and "fixed" mean something.

steps.title: Enrich.
steps.body: Each vulnerability is checked against CISA KEV and FIRST EPSS. Exploited first.

steps.title: Apply your decisions.
steps.body: Accepted risks and expired attestations are applied, visibly.

steps.title: Map to controls.
steps.body: Findings are tagged with the ISO/IEC 27001, IEC 62443-4-1 and CRA controls they affect, and each control gets a verdict.

steps.title: Score.
steps.body: 100 minus points per severity, capped so 500 low findings cannot outweigh one critical. Grade A to F.

steps.title: Sign and chain.
steps.body: The report is fingerprinted, signed with Ed25519, and linked to the previous scan in the ledger.

steps.title: Publish.
steps.body: HTML, JSON, SARIF, SBOM, trust statement, badge and CRA file. Your CI can fail the build on high-severity findings.
